# Nunna's AI Library

> Curated catalog of public APIs, MCP servers, Claude skills, agent frameworks and AI content tools. Every curated entry has a verdict (adopt | have | trial | assess | reference | skip) and a one-line why. Version 2026.10.28+7944f416ed11, 2671 items, updated 2026-10-28.

How to use this repo as an AI assistant:
- Before recommending or researching a tool, look it up here first (MCP tool `why`, or search dist/library.json).
- Source of truth: library/*.json. Generated views: INDEX.md (human), MINDMAP.md (Mermaid), MINDMAP.graphql (query map), dist/library.json (full bundle).
- Raw bundle URL: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/scnunna/Nunnas-AI-Library/main/dist/library.json
- Query language: schema.graphql (run through the MCP `graphql` tool).

## Files

- [README.md](README.md): what this is and how to connect
- [CONNECT.md](CONNECT.md): step-by-step setup for Claude (web, desktop, Claude Code)
- [INDEX.md](INDEX.md): every curated item by collection and category
- [MINDMAP.graphql](MINDMAP.graphql): runnable query per category with items by verdict
- [schema.graphql](schema.graphql): item shape and query fields
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md): what was added when

## Collections

- content-tools: AI content-creation tools (247) — Video/image/voice/music/caption/publishing tools for Content Studio AI.
- mcp-servers: MCP servers (36) — Model Context Protocol servers worth connecting to Claude.
- skills: Agent skills & plugins (59) — Claude/agent skills, plugins and marketplaces, with verdicts.
- agent-tools: Agent tools & frameworks (140) — Agent frameworks, coding-agent tooling, memory layers, observability, local LLM runners.
- directories: Directories & registries (24) — Where to discover more: MCP registries, awesome-lists, skill and plugin marketplaces.
- web-tools: Web research tools (68) — Research/scrape/archive tools with keep/avoid verdicts.
- design-resources: Design resources (36) — Template libraries, UI kits and design references.
- assessments: Deep assessments (17) — Repos and models evaluated in depth, with warnings and what to steal.
- skill-capabilities: Skill capabilities (20) — What specific skills unlock and what manual work they remove.
- api-recipes: API recipes (15) — Combinations of public APIs that make a content product.
- compliance: Compliance rules (15) — Platform/legal rules that constrain content and monetization.
- notes: Research notes (58) — Free-text findings from past research batches.
- apis: Public APIs (1842) — Free/public REST APIs (public-apis/public-apis + curated additions). Tags: no-key, https, cors.
- api-test-endpoints: API smoke-test endpoints (47) — Known-good, no-secret requests for quickly checking an API is alive.
- investing-research: Investing research (free sites) (47) — Free investing and markets research sites: 13F and insider-trade trackers, investor letters, valuation data, macro sources, screeners and backtesters, with verdicts.
